boundaries: S is an image-supported observation candidate and an exploratory question, not a confirmed geological interpretation or an expert-validated science priority.
The 20-minute starting observation allowance is an editable scenario input; the application does not prescribe a real field protocol.
The crop is a nearest-neighbor enlargement of the prepared contrast-stretched, lossy optical display. It does not add native spatial detail or provide calibrated reflectance.
Physical access, line of sight, material composition, real-time conditions, full accessibility, human usability and actual hosting remain separate validation work.
Historical exact five-canvas hashes retain their earlier release scope; adding the visible S annotation intentionally changes current map images.
